column7: A CreateSession storage error after MarkTOTPStepUsed burned the TOTP code without minting a session. The login path now releases the just-consumed step when the session cannot be minted (ReleaseTOTPStepIfUnchanged) while still issuing no session on the faulted call; the test retries the SAME code with a fresh challenge after the fault clears. The step-up path stays consume-first by design. Found by ISSUE-TRIAGE-1 (2026-10-17).
